title: Dictionary pack manifest
description: One manifest.json per pack. Declares identity, licence, visibility and checksum; a decoding engine loads packs by manifest and knows no dictionary by name.

pack_id.description: Unique pack id, lowercase with hyphens, e.g. 'pack-a'.

orthography.description: Spelling scheme of the entries and the notation stored on import.

entries.description: Number of valid lines in lexicon.jsonl.

sha256.description: SHA-256 of lexicon.jsonl, used for run ids and integrity checks.

license.description: Licence name; uploader-declared public domain must be marked 'uploader-declared'.

allowed_uses.description: Permitted uses; anything not listed is unauthorised.

visibility.description: public may ship with an open repository; private stays local; restricted needs written permission. Note that git does not read this field: whether a pack is committed is decided by .gitignore.

priority.description: Homograph priority, lower wins; defaults to 100.

source.description: Upstream source; doi / url / file / row_count recommended.

provenance.description: Chain of custody, e.g. 'source edition -> orthography scheme -> IPA'.
